 India captain Shreyas Iyer has won his fourth consecutive toss and chosen to bowl in the fourth Twenty20 cricket international against New Zealand at Eden Park. Bowling first was a winning formula in the first three matches of the five-match series which it won by four wickets, four wickets and six wickets to take a 3-0 series lead. Although the series is decided, Eden Park is sold out for the match and India has been encouraged by coach Gautam Gambhir to treat the remaining two matches as a separate series.

 AUCKLAND, New Zealand (AP) — India captain Shreyas Iyer won his fourth consecutive toss and chose to bowl Friday in the fourth Twenty20 cricket international against New Zealand at Eden Park.
 Bowling first was a winning formula in the first three matches of the five-match series which India won by four wickets, four wickets and six wickets to take a 3-0 series lead.
